messages:
Maya: Quick take 18: we need a very slim alpha for Optimize recommendations: batching + cache hints, quant as an offline report, and eval-alert webhooks. Can we do it in 2 sprints?

Raj: Yes if quant is offline-only. Recommender service + alerter + tiny Console tile. No runtime quant changes.

Lina: Must have customer gold sets and telemetry: tokens_saved, eval_mismatch_rate, p95 latency delta. Need samples by EOD Fri.

ACME-Beth: (via Maya) ACME can share 300 gold prompts and wants quant report with estimated cost savings. Manual approval only.

Mateo: Platform needs: feature-flag opt-in, webhook support with HMAC, SDK event for accept/reject. I can do flag+webhook sprint 1, SDK events sprint 2.

Priya: Console UX: one card with top 3 recs + accept/reject and an alert config modal (threshold + webhook). Mock by Wed.

Jorge: Acceptance checks: <=3% quality regression on gold set, p95 delta <= +25ms, >=10% tokens_saved on batchy traffic. Hold on failures.

Maya: Action items: Raj design doc Tue, Mateo flags plan Wed, Priya mockups Wed, Lina thresholds Fri, Jorge test checklist Fri. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

All: +1
